'''Mark Schaffer''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 41 in the Tatooine region, from Hampton, Va.<ref name="decsq-prof" /> The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" />

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| Decipher era || [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 41 (Hampton, Va)<ref name="smlist">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Squadron Members], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (geocities.ws/plarathas). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009142705/https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/SMs.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|-
| Decipher era || Helped run Sci-Con in Virginia Beach; got Decipher to hold a Regional qualifier there<ref name="decsq-prof">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/schaffermark.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Gold 41 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001119082200/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/schaffermark.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|-
| Decipher era || Ran weekly demos, a league and two to three tournaments a month in Hampton Roads<ref name="decsq-prof" />
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
